linak.name: LINAK Controller
linak.description: Electron app to automate IKEA LINAK standing desks with sit/stand presets, weekday schedules and Web Bluetooth.
linak.intro: Desktop app to automate an IKEA LINAK height-adjustable desk. It can switch to a given position at specific times or toggle automatically between sitting and standing, so the standing desk actually gets used throughout the day.
linak.info1: Connect to the desk over Web Bluetooth, without pairing it in the operating system.
linak.info2: Show the current height in centimeters, inches or millimeters.
linak.info3: Move to a seated or standing position with a single click.
linak.info4: Hold the up/down controls to nudge the desk to any height, and stop movement at any time.
linak.info5: Create weekday schedules that toggle sit/stand or jump to a specific position.
linak.info6: Run automation in the background with a sound and overlay reminder when it is time to change posture.
linak.info7: Live in the system tray and auto-connect to the last desk on launch.
